'''2010 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, 12–15 August 2010, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="forum">https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=559</ref><ref name="decklists">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2010-decklists/</ref><ref name="standings">https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=75427</ref> Published lists on the Players Committee 2010 decklists desk are the Day 2 and Day 3 PDFs only (no Day 1 or Team Tournament PDF was published). [[Dan Kim]] defeated [[Kyle Krueger]] in the final.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
* '''Dates:''' 12–15 August 2010
* '''Winner:''' [[Dan Kim]]

Day 3 Xerox sheets are in [[:File:2010 Worlds Day 3.pdf]] (14 published lists; blank pages 11–12). [[Kyle Krueger]] reached the final per standings history but has no sheet in the published Day 3 PDF. [[Chris Twiss]] Light and [[Chris Terwilliger]] Dark are one-side-only in that PDF. Steve Baroni Dark (They've Shut Down The Main Reactor (V) / Dry Clean Only) remains unpublished pending lines 31–40 reconcile (58-count HOLD).

== Day 2 ==

Day 2 Xerox sheets are in [[:File:2010 Worlds Day 2.pdf]] (123 pages; 112 content lists + 11 blanks). Rows linked as each list is transcribed. [[Kyle Krueger]] has Day 2 Dark only in the PDF (no Day 2 Light; no Day 3 sheet). Barry Alperstein Dark (ISB) held pending line 5 "Location x3" (V) reconcile.
